ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all identified UBOs, directors, authorized signatories, and their immediate family members and close associates against OFAC SDN, UN Security Council, EU Consolidated, UK HMT, and Vanuatu FIU/domestic sanctions lists. Enhanced due diligence applies to any positive PEP match, high-risk jurisdiction exposure, or politically exposed person controlling a corporate shareholder. Re-screening every 90 days and ongoing transaction monitoring are required under VFSC AML/CFT directives.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Registry / VFSC e-Recording and Company Search Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in Latin script and may be in English or French. Bislama is not accepted. Foreign-language names must be accompanied by a certified English or French transliteration and may be rejected if phonetically or visually identical to an existing registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be extended once for an additional 30 days by filing a written extension request with VFSC before expiry. Upon rejection, the applicant may submit a written reconsideration request to the Registrar within 14 days of the rejection notice, attaching a statutory declaration demonstrating the name's distinctiveness and, where applicable, prior written consent from the relevant ministry or sector regulator. An administrative appeal lies to the VFSC Board of Commissioners in accordance with the International Companies Act, Cap 222.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as the statutory registered office. A physical office in Vanuatu maintained by a VFSC-licensed registered agent is mandatory. Virtual or remote headquarters are acceptable only for offshore trading operations and do not satisfy the registered office requirement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated <5% per annum) for wholesale commodity arbitrage operations. VFSC may conduct structured on-site reviews of the registered agent's premises, but unannounced physical inspection of the International Company's offshore trading premises is unlikely absent a complaint, AML trigger, or regulatory investigation.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1992, applicable incorporation provisions ss. 4–15; registered agent and registered office obligations; Companies Act [Cap. 191] not applicable to an International Company
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Company Registry, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of the International Company, submitted in duplicate through a licensed VFSC registered agent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; no escrow account or capital deposit requirement under the International Companies Act 1992. Share capital may be denominated in any currency and allotted at par or premium.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the execution and submission of the Memorandum and Articles of Association by the subscriber to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission be and is hereby ratified and confirmed. RESOLVED that the shares subscribed under the Memorandum be and are hereby allotted to the initial shareholder in accordance with the Articles. RESOLVED that [Subscriber A] and [Subscriber B] are appointed First Directors. RESOLVED that the registered office established c/o the licensed registered agent be and is hereby adopted. RESOLVED that [Corporate Secretary Ltd] is appointed Company Secretary. RESOLVED FURTHER that the directors are authorised to open bank accounts, negotiate sugar purchase contracts, and execute vessel charter documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage licensed registered agent and reserve international company name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a registered agent engagement contract; instruct the agent to submit a name reservation request to VFSC; obtain signed consents from proposed directors and company secretary.
required_dossiers: Certified passport copy of each shareholder and director
Proposed company name and two alternative names
Brief business plan showing international sugar wholesale activity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected, submit a fresh name reservation with a distinct suffix or file an administrative appeal within seven days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare and file constitutional documents with VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with the International Companies Act 1992. File Form IC-1, consents, registered office notice, and the constitutional documents through the registered agent. Verify all signatures are notarized where requested.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association in duplicate
Consent to act as director signed by each director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues a query or requisition, amend and re-file the constitutional documents within fourteen days and pay any rectification fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pay statutory fees and obtain certificate of incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Company Registry and revenue desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the registration and filing fees to VFSC; upon satisfaction of filing requirements, collect the Certificate of Incorporation and open the statutory registers maintained by the registered agent.
required_dossiers: Receipt of payment of registration fees
Certified copy of the approved Memorandum and Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If issuance of the certificate is delayed by a fee mismatch or rejected filing, remit the corrected fee and receive the amended certificate via the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adopt first board resolution and complete corporate records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: First board of directors and company secretary, supported by the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting, adopt the pro-forma board resolution, allot the subscription shares, appoint first officers, issue share certificates, and complete registers of members and directors at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first board meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any corporate record is rejected by a counterparty or VFSC, convene a further board meeting and adopt corrective resolutions; late filing penalties are avoided by expedited correction.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial licensing board is engaged for this offshore wholesale scope
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required for an International Company transacting exclusively outside the domestic Vanuatu market

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt for offshore commodity trading and vessel transhipment; no scheduled onshore processing activity is undertaken
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Vessel ballast water management under the International Maritime Organization Ballast Water Management Convention 2004; zero discharge of cargo residue into Vanuatu waters; compliance with MARPOL Annex IV and Annex V during loading and transhipment

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance from the Vanuatu Fire Service for vessel and wharf operations; structural and mooring load inspection by the Vanuatu Maritime and Ports Authority; occupational health and safety clearance under the Vanuatu OHS legislation for administrative offices and stevedore contracts

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Service (VRCS), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; company and international company registry administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC). Official portals: https://vrcs.gov.vu and https://vfsc.vu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Vanuatu International Company (IC) is incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] through a licensed registered agent in Port Vila. The agent lodges the memorandum and articles, registers the registered office and agent, and files the declaration of exempt status; the VFSC Registrar then issues the Certificate of Incorporation and, where applied for, a Tax Exemption Certificate confirming relief from all direct taxation. Because Vanuatu imposes no income tax, corporate tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax, or VAT, a separate statutory VAT ID is not issued. The IC obtains a TIN (Tax Identification Number) from the VRCS principally for customs, import duty, and statistical records; for physical trading premises, a business license must be obtained from the Vanuatu Investment Authority or the relevant provincial/municipal council.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Not applicable. Vanuatu has no check-the-box, entity-classification election, or hybrid mismatch election because its domestic law imposes no entity-level or pass-through income tax. An International Company may elect statutory 'exempt company' status under the International Companies Act [Cap 222], evidenced by a certificate issued by the VFSC Registrar; a foreign company may continue or redomicile in Vanuatu and retain its foreign hybrid classification for the purposes of foreign tax law. No CFC, thin-capitalization, ATAD, or public CbCR filing elections apply.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None (no VAT, GST, or sales/use tax operationally in force); customs import duties under the Customs Act [Cap 38], zero-export duty, and tourism-specific levies apply. A Value Added Tax Act was certified but its commencement remains deferred by successive government orders; until operational commencement, the effective indirect tax burden on sugar commodity exports is nil.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable for VAT/GST. Customs importer registration is required for recurring clearance regardless of transactional value; a business license is required from the relevant authority where any economic activity occurs. No minimum threshold is prescribed for registration as an International Company engaged in wholesale export trading.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API, or digital stamping mandate is in force. Customs declarations and clearance are processed electronically through the ASYCUDA World system operated by the VRCS Customs Division; traders submit electronic entries with supporting documents retained per Customs Act requirements. No national e-invoice clearance authority is designated.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. With no operative VAT/GST, export sales of VHP raw cane centrifugal sugar (HS 1701.14) are not zero-rated and no input VAT refund mechanism arises. Duty treatment is exclusively customs-based: physical ocean exports are free of export duty and export taxes, and duty-free or dutiable status depends on the import tariff regime in the destination country, not on Vanuatu zero-rating rules. Any preferential duty claim in the importing jurisdiction is supported by a Vanuatu Certificate of Origin.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Vanuatu SAD / ASYCUDA World entry)
Bill of Lading evidencing physical ocean shipment to the overseas buyer
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT/LC documentary evidence of payment proceeds
Certificate of Origin (for any preferential tariff claim)
Shipping authority letter and, where requested, VFSC corporate standing certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu maintains no exchange-control regime, so no statutory FX repatriation deadline is imposed; the 180-day convention is adopted contractually and evidenced by LC/SWIFT records for customs and bank audit files. Customs penalties for false declaration, undervaluation, or smuggling include forfeiture of goods, fines up to VUV 200,000, and imprisonment under the Customs Act [Cap 38]; mis-declaration may be reassessed with a 10% surcharge. Misuse of the VFSC Tax Exemption Certificate risks revocation and recovery of any duties or taxes otherwise payable in full, together with disqualification of the IC and its directors by the Registrar. Fraudulent export documentation, including fabricated bills of lading or inward remittance certificates, may attract criminal liabilities under the Penal Code and the Financial Dealers Act and is treated by VFSC-licensed banks and agents as high-scrutiny conduct.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) acting as the delegated Exchange Control authority under the Exchange Control Act [Cap 108]; foreign exchange administration is executed through RBV-licensed Authorised Dealers (ADs) operating in Port Vila and Luganville.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu Vatu (VUV) is a convertible currency pegged to an undisclosed trade-weighted basket anchored primarily to USD and AUD. Current-account items (trade settlements, freight, insurance, agency fees) are freely convertible without individual exchange-control approval. The capital account is substantially open: a Vanuatu International Company (VU_IC) may issue shares to non-residents and freely remit dividends, liquidation proceeds, and management fees without any statutory tax or convertibility hurdle, subject only to bank-level AML/KYC verification and VFSC annual licence renewal. No profit-remittance tax, dividend withholding tax, or capital gains tax applies to the IC's foreign-source VHP raw sugar trading income under the tax-exempt IC regime.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender of export proceeds and no mandatory VUV conversion ratio exist in Vanuatu. A VU_IC may retain 100% of raw cane sugar export proceeds in USD or any freely usable currency in its Vanuatu AD account or offshore account. ADs must submit external transaction statistics to the RBV for balance-of-payments purposes, but there is no repatriation timeline, no conversion mandate, and no minimum holding period for export receipts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD/VUV Account with Revolving LC Facility

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. Vanuatu has no dedicated EMI or neo-bank licensing statute; the Banking Act [Cap 34] and the International Banking Act [Cap 139] reserve deposit-taking, payment clearing, and trade credit functions for licenced banks. VFSC Category licences cover securities and financial dealers, not clearing banks. Reputable offshore EMIs (Airwallex, Currenxie, Revolut Business, and similar) generally decline Vanuatu ICs because of correspondent-bank de-risking and the offshore-IC perception profile; an EMI may serve only as a secondary expense/FX rail, never as the primary liquidity or LC clearing channel for raw sugar trades.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote account opening is permitted under Vanuatu's AML/CFT regime when a VFSC-licensed registered agent certifies passport copies, proof of address, and incorporation documents; there is no statutory requirement for physical attendance in Vanuatu. In practice, the AD bank requires a live audio-visual interview with each director or authorised signatory, an original or notarised board resolution appointing signatories, and a banker's reference from the originator bank. For LC facilities above USD 1,000,000, banks typically require one embassy-notarised signing session or a physical visit to Port Vila by one director, or alternatively a local registered-agent attestation executed under a power of attorney; pure in-office appearance is not mandatory if the agent's KYC file is complete.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bearer shares or undisclosed nominee shareholders under the International Companies Act [Cap 222].
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificates confirming cancellation of any bearer instruments; certified Register of Members, Directors, and Secretaries; beneficial ownership schedule filed with the VFSC; signed declaration of economic ownership from each ultimate beneficial owner (UBO); Registered Agent's non-transaction letter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid in/out credit velocity with no operational substance in Vanuatu (same-day credit to third-party sugar suppliers or refiners).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Economic-substance narrative: board minutes executed at the Port Vila registered office, signatory governance chart, management agreement with the local registered agent, and a funds-flow map matching each outbound wire to a dated invoice, bill of lading, or LC drawing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Geographic counterparty red flags in raw sugar origination (Brazil, Thailand, India, Indonesia, or Dubai-based trading intermediaries).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original sale/purchase contract; full-set ocean B/L consigned to the order of the LC issuing bank; SGS, Intertek, or ISO-certified certificate of analysis and loading weight; phytosanitary certificate; vessel IMO registry and ISM SMC excerpt; cargo insurance certificate covering the named voyage.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party disbursement to a refinery or terminal that differs from the named contractual buyer (chain-of-title break).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed novation or resale addendum; refinery acceptance and landing weight notes; updated master sales memorandum; substituted beneficiary's irrevocable LC or authenticated payment undertaking; bank-certified corporate registry excerpt of the substituted payee.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-bank offshore lender requesting assignment of LC proceeds or invoice discounting secured against the Vanuatu IC's book debts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed assignment agreement with written consent of the LC issuing bank; full UBO/KYC file of the lender; audited financial statements of the lender; board resolution authorising the charge; regulatory opinion confirming the charge creates no Vanuatu withholding or stamp exposure.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Non-resident shareholders remit via SWIFT MT103 from a recognised international bank to the IC's USD account held at a Vanuatu AD. Beneficiary field 59 must state the IC legal name and VFSC registration number; field 70 (Remittance Information) must read 'SHARE CAPITAL INJECTION - VU_IC' together with the allotment resolution date. The AD applies the Exchange Control (General) Exemption Order to effect the credit without prior RBV approval, but requires the originator's banker reference, the certified share allotment resolution, and a source-of-funds declaration. No minimum paid-up capital is required by the VFSC; nevertheless, a first deposit of USD 20,000-50,000 is recommended to activate the trade-finance credit profile and satisfy the AD's internal rating model.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail: Revolving Commercial Letter of Credit (SWIFT MT700/MT707) issued by the Vanuatu AD or, for lines above USD 5,000,000, issued in Port Vila and confirmed by a Singapore or Hong Kong position bank settling in USD via Fedwire/CHIPS. Supplier payments for VHP sugar cargoes use sight or 30-90 day usance drawings, with documents presented at the beneficiary's counters and reimbursement via MT103/MT202 cover. Freight and insurance use MT103 with field 70 citing 'VOYAGE NUMBER - POL/POD - GRADE VHP' plus the vessel IMO reference. Sale-side proceeds enter via an incoming export LC advised through the Vanuatu AD and discounted at approximately 90-110 basis points above SOFR. Fallback rail: documentary collection (D/P or D/A) against pre-screened Asian counterparties only, to eliminate open-account transit exposure on cargoes in transit.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/VUV outright forward contracts with RBV-licensed Authorised Dealers (ANZ, BSP, BRED) with tenors up to 12 months, collateralised by cash margin or trade receivables.
Offshore USD/VUV non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) under ISDA 2002 with a Singapore or Sydney prime broker, settled in USD because VUV is non-deliverable beyond Vanuatu banking channels.
USD/AUD and USD/CNH deliverable forwards or swaps executed with the Vanuatu AD's offshore treasury desk, used to hedge freight, port handling, and refinery-consumable costs.

Cross-currency swaps (USD principal versus VUV) with an Authorised Dealer, subject to RBV notification where a Vanuatu-resident counterparty is involved; plain-vanilla structures only, with speculative VUV option positions restricted by AD internal policy.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and License Renewal for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due no later than 30 calendar days after the anniversary date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Escalating late fees imposed per month of delinquency; continued non-filing for six or more consecutive months exposes the company to administrative strike-off and deregistration from the Vanuatu International Companies Register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation of Registered Office and Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same anniversary window as the Annual Return, typically filed concurrently
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a licensed registered agent in Vanuatu may result in immediate suspension of corporate registration and strike-off action without further notice.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit requirement for a Vanuatu International Company unless the company is licensed under a separate Vanuatu financial regulatory regime, carries on local business requiring a local license, or a court orders an audit. Otherwise, financial statements may remain unaudited.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory accounting standard imposed; if financial statements are voluntarily prepared, IFRS is the recommended and predominantly accepted framework. Records must nevertheless be adequate to present a true and fair view of the company's affairs under the International Companies Act.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The annual return must confirm the current register of members and record any share transfers made during the preceding year. Where a nominee or custodian holds shares, the ultimate beneficial owner must be identified to the registered agent for compliance with the International Companies Act, and any resulting register entries must be completed before filing.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required; if voluntarily prepared, USD 1,500 – USD 3,500 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - no general corporate income tax. Vanuatu abolished income taxation in 1990 (Income Tax Act repealed); neither the State nor the VFSC levies CIT, PIT, CGT, payroll, or estate taxes.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective rate for a properly licensed International Company (IC) under s.117 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]: the IC is wholly exempt from income tax, capital gains tax, and all duties on worldwide non-Vanuatu activity. Exports of physical VHP raw centrifugal cane sugar are zero-rated for the 12.5% VAT; an IC engaged only in offshore trading holds no VAT registration. No tax deductions or incentives apply because no tax base exists.
